topic: Your car alarm keeps going off for no reason — again
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Your car alarm goes off at two in the morning — again — and nothing's wrong.
beats.visualPrompt: Wide static shot of a car parked on a dark residential street at night, headlights flashing in sync with an alarm chirp, porch light glow in the background; quick cut to a close-up of a dashboard alarm indicator LED blinking red through the windshield.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2s sub-shots (flashing headlights, blinking dash LED) before real generation.

beats.narration: No broken glass, no forced entry. Just the alarm, blaring, for no clear reason.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on an intact, undisturbed door handle and lock cylinder, no damage visible, night lighting; cut to a wide shot of the same car's windshield and side glass, fully intact, confirming no break-in.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (door handle, intact glass) before real generation.

beats.narration: Most random alarms trace back to one of two things — the hood latch switch, or the key fob battery.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro shot of a hood latch mechanism under an open hood, pin and switch visible, daylight garage setting, static camera; cut to a close-up of a key fob resting on a workbench, battery-compartment cover removed, no hands in frame.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (hood latch, fob on bench) before real generation.

beats.narration: A loose hood pin switch can send a false 'break-in' signal. A weak fob battery can do the same thing.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro cutaway of a hood-latch pin switch shown slightly misaligned/loose on a workbench rig, slow push-in; cut to a close-up of a coin-cell battery beside an open fob compartment, static overhead shot.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (loose latch switch, coin-cell battery) before real generation.

beats.narration: Checking those two spots first can rule out the most common causes before anything else.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up of a hood-latch switch and a small diagnostic multimeter display showing a continuity reading, both resting on a workbench, static overhead shot, warm garage lighting.

beats.narration: One clue, easy to check. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
beats.postCompositing: Real logo and CTA text overlay added in post via ffmpeg, never AI-generated.
